body: In AMIP runs with `land_model: "integrated"`, `land_spun_up_ic: false`, and `era5_initial_condition_dir` set, `land_ic_path` remained `nothing` because `SimCoordinator._build_coupled_simulation` only resolved ERA5 initial condition paths for `SubseasonalMode`. Integrated `ClimaLand` then fell back to `set_ic_default!` and initialized with zero snow everywhere.
title: Start the AMIP land from ERA5-Land when ERA5 initial conditions are set
